title: dev-mode AUTHINFO bypass has no tracing::warn
description: In lifecycle.rs, the dev-mode auth bypass path (is_dev_mode() => accepted = true) has no tracing::warn. An operator who deploys without credentials gets no log evidence that authentication is being bypassed. Add: warn!(peer = %peer_addr, username = %username, 'AUTHINFO: dev mode — authentication bypassed (no credentials configured)'); immediately before granting access.
